plan.budget_relationship: No extension or transfer of exhausted optimization slots. A uses no design search; B one owner-requested structural hypothesis; C three isolated controls, each below the existing 12-vector reservation. Unused designs are not searched.

A.falsification: A claimed full-envelope authority region is falsified by retained leakage1G failures, transistor loss of active region, missing process coverage or saturation. Local scenario feasibility is distinct.
A.question: Does source-voltage feedback materially enlarge no-trim authority under equal capsule, interface and coupled model stresses?
A.stop: Execute the predeclared finite grid once; retain all failed cells. No bias fit, trimming or threshold change. No structural A child without an independently supported remedy.

B.caveat: Constant IR/ESR and 10-50nH are explicit supplementary assumptions; discrete 20C IR/DF does not bound broadband/temperature/excess noise. Nominal uses adverse source-anchored IR/DF, not omitted losses.
B.falsification: No resolved nominal noise reduction, >1dB response, adverse authority loss, startup failure, or unavailable loop evidence prevents the respective improvement/qualification claim.
B.question: Does a final-backplate 100nF PP filter reduce conditional electronics noise without losing DC authority or audio response?
B.stop: One value only, no optimization. Preserve unfiltered parent. Unknown physical capsule bias remains unknown.

C.falsification: Two-port mismatch or native-noise regression rejects simultaneous benefit; missing KF/process/thermal or startup prevents qualification.
C.question: Can ordinary full manufacturer driver alternatives reduce noise and conductor impedance imbalance at unchanged bias/passives?
C.stop: Three exact full files, three temperatures, three finite loads. No model borrowing or parameter fitting. Only integrate an alternative if all supported port/noise screens improve; otherwise retain isolated failed alternatives.

plan.options: reltol=1e-6 abstol=1e-16 vntol=1e-10 gmin=1e-15 method=gear maxord=2

prerequisites.nonlinear: Prompt8 full DUT remains unsupported; complete-suite errors retained, no harmonics/headroom claim.
prerequisites.production: No measured joint device population, complete spectra, SOA or physical measurements.

plan.recovery: Source pressure-free supply dip; 0-5s fixed observation/1ms maximum step, same original timeout60s; retain final source/servo/backplate residuals and censoring.
plan.refinement: Nominal noise 64/128 points per decade and AC 32/64; retain deltas, no tiny-difference ranking.
plan.return_ratio: Preserve DC through a zero-DC injection at the sense path; compare both orientations/loading. Report voltage-return diagnostic only unless bilateral injection and open-loop pole prerequisites are satisfied. Quiet closed-loop traces never pass stability.
plan.scope: Prompt 9 finite model-conditional A/B/C tests; no topology or PCB selection

validation.deterministic: Shared capsule/interface endpoints plus complete weak/strong files and two tolerance/TCR endpoints; no joint process/yield interpretation.
validation.independent: 16 scenarios; generate common quantiles once by union key; equal external/shared-part ranges give identical values, different source-resistor designs keep their own ranges; artificial uniform/log-uniform only. Holdouts are not used for value selection.
validation.passive: Child C ±10%, Rback ±1%, documented output capacitors ±20% independent/opposed, source-anchored film IR/loss plus assumed inductance endpoints.
